data_product_description: This dashboard shows contract and performer-level dental activity for Local Health Boards in Wales, helping commissioners review services and download data for planning.
data_product_overview:
## Data Product Overview
There is a need for dental commissioners to be able to monitor the activity of dental contracts within a specific Local Health Board.  This allows them to ensure that services as commissioned effectively and to maximise the benefit to patients.

To enable this a series of dashboards are available within the eDEN system to allow users to access a range of dental data including detailed information extracted from the FP17.

The dashboard provides information relating to Welsh dental activity at Local Health Board level for a range of different metrics, allowing users to visualise data within the system and to quickly download data relating to those metrics.
